exams.name: Home Inspector Competency Examination
exams.notes: Oral, written, or electronic; administered by the department or contracted testing service at least three times per year. Interns may attempt up to three times within one year; after failing the third exam, must wait one year before re-examination.
exams.quote: Have passed an oral, written or electronic competency examination administered by the department

interval_years.quote: All licenses issued under the provisions of this section shall expire biennially and may be renewed upon application and payment to the department of a renewal fee

renewal_fee_usd.quote: may be renewed upon application and payment to the department of a renewal fee in the amount of two hundred fifty dollars

required.quote: establish continuing education requirements and standards of professional and ethical conduct for home inspectors

requirements.value: Payment of $100 fee and submission of written application; applicant must hold a valid license from another state with standards substantially equivalent to or exceeding Connecticut's standards, as determined by the department.
requirements.quote: Upon payment to the department of a fee in the amount of one hundred dollars and the submission of a written application provided by the department, the department shall issue a home inspector license to any person who holds a valid license issued by another state with standards substantially equivalent to or exceeding the standards of this state, as determined by the department.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: conducts home inspection without having first obtained the license or permit required by said sections

disciplinary_grounds.quote: falsely pretends to qualify to conduct home inspection

disciplinary_grounds.description: Applicant or licensee subject to sex offender registration requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: upon a finding that a person applying for or renewing a home inspector license or home inspector intern permit is subject to the registration requirements of chapter 969, the board may refuse to issue or renew the home inspector license or home inspector intern permit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any cause specified in subsection (c) of section 21a-9 (general disciplinary grounds for licensed professions under Department of Consumer Protection)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may, by majority vote of the entire board and upon a finding of any cause specified in subsection (c) of section 21a-9

definition_quote.value: Home inspection means an examination and written evaluation of two or more of the following components of a residential building: Heating, cooling, plumbing and electrical systems, structural components, foundation, roof, masonry, structure, exterior and interior components and any other related residential housing components
definition_quote.quote: "Home inspection" means an examination and written evaluation of two or more of the following components of a residential building: Heating, cooling, plumbing and electrical systems, structural components, foundation, roof, masonry, structure, exterior and interior components and any other related residential housing components, as set forth in regulations adopted by the commissioner

value: examination of exterior and interior components
methods_authorized.quote: an examination and written evaluation of two or more of the following components of a residential building: Heating, cooling, plumbing and electrical systems, structural components, foundation, roof, masonry, structure, exterior and interior components and any other related residential housing components

license_tier.quote: "Home inspector" means a person licensed in accordance with the provisions of section 20-492a or subsection (b) of section 20-492b

trainee_intern_registration_required.quote: "Home inspector intern" means a person who is in training to become a home inspector under the supervision of a home inspector licensed in accordance with the provisions of section 20-492a or subsection (b) of section 20-492b

minimum_inspections_for_licensure.quote: Have earned a home inspector intern permit and performed not less than one hundred home inspections in accordance with subsection (c) of section 20-493b

supervision_model.value: direct for first N inspections then indirect
supervision_model.quote: Such supervision shall be direct supervision for a minimum of the first ten inspections, and then may be indirect for the remaining training period.

supervisor_liability_for_trainee.quote: The licensed home inspector supervising the home inspector intern shall be responsible for all inspections done by the home inspector intern under the licensed home inspector's charge.

trainee_cosign_permitted.quote: "direct supervision" means the supervisor shall be present at the site of a home inspection where the home inspector intern is assigned one hundred per cent of the time and such supervisor shall countersign all documents prepared and completed by the home inspector intern.

pre_inspection_agreement_required.quote: Prior to performing a home inspection, each licensee shall inform the client, in writing, that the licensee's work is subject to regulation by the department and that inquiries and complaints concerning the licensee's work may be directed to the department.

smoke_detector_reporting_required.quote: The minimum and uniform standard for a home inspection shall include a requirement that a home inspector report on the presence of smoke detection and warning equipment and specify where such equipment is located, the total number of such equipment, whether the home inspector is able to test such equipment, and whether the home inspector is able to verify that such equipment was less than ten years old.

residential_unit_maximum.quote: "Residential building" means a structure that is intended to be or is in fact used as a residence consisting of from one to four family dwelling units
